name: duck-viewport
title: Duck Viewport
description: A pan and zoom container for somebody else's canvas: cursor-anchored wheel zoom, pointer-drag panning with capture, two-finger pinch, and the keyboard. The wheel listener is registered by hand with passive: false, because React's onWheel cannot preventDefault and the page scrolls out from under the zoom. The transform is written straight to element.style, so a pan costs no renders.
